lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Enemy down.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Pssh, if it hadn't snuck up on us, that thing wouldn't have been a challenge at all.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Let's get in the Lift.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You don't have to tell me twice.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text:
There might be enemy units inside.
Everyone be on your guard.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Is everything all right with the spacesuit, Commander?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: All good. I've always wanted to wear one of these. I couldn't sleep last night, I was so excited.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: ... Uh-huh. Well then, let's go.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Hmm...?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Ouch! Dang, that's bright.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Looks like the sun came out to welcome us.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: How clichéd can you get?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text:
Check out the sky, Snow.
Isn't it beautif...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Everyone. Look over there.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Do you know what that is?
Everyone stares at where Red Hood points.
Off in the distance, a bit too far to make out clearly, there is an indistinct figure.
Floating in the air, with the sun on their back, is the form of a human.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Is it me, or does that look like a human?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Perhaps it's a new type of decoy? I thought they'd given up the notion of air superiority, but they might have changed their minds.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: 'Tis a most peculiar shape for a decoy.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... It just moved.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text:
Something's coming out of it...
Is it... splitting apart?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It looks like a giant, wet...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Rapunzel, are you okay?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: It's all my fault for corrupting her.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text:
Let me see. 
Does anyone have binoculars?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Why don't you just use the zoom function on your phone?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text:
Good call.
Snow White, always coming in clutch with the tech tips.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: ... I thought this was common knowledge.
The Commander looks at the silhouette with his phone camera.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: I don't think that's a decoy.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: ... Hmmm?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: It's Cinderella.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: The face is exactly the same as the one I received in the dossier.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text:
I can see the Glass Slippers as well.
But her eyes...

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Everyone! Take cover!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Get ready to counterattack!
A hailstorm of bright blue light beams fills the entire sky, like luminescent water droplets,
and begins to rain down on the party.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text:
What the hell are these things?!
Are all of them beams?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text:
There's no way we can evade them.
Rapunzel!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: On it!
Rapunzel manifests a golden halo which floats atop the party.
The numerous light beams falling from the sky are all diffused in different directions.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: She's firing another volley!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What?! Again?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I'll try to block it!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Red Hood, under and over!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Got it. She's mine!
Rapunzel conjures up another halo which diverts the next barrage of light beams.
Red Hood quickly gets into a shooting stance, and then fires a single shot towards Cinderella.
The four floating objects surrounding Cinderella all coalesce into one solid shape.
The bullet fired by Red Hood flies towards the unidentified mass, which is cylindrical in shape.
The cylinder appears to reflect the bullet and rebounds it back.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: It reflected it?!
*Crash*
Amid a massive cloud of dust, Red Hood is hurled backward.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Red Hood!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We've got more beams incoming!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: What is this?! There's no way she's controlling that many beams by herself.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I'm low on power! I can't create any more distortion rings!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: I shall sever her in two.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Don't be insane. Just hold on tight.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Commander, cover your mouth and nose.
Liliweiss picks up everyone and starts running.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Yee! So fast!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I-I can't breathe...!

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Deal with it! This is our only chance of escaping.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Why are we escaping?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: We can't win!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: My ass we can't! I'll...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: If you're so intent on dying, at least wait until we've defeated this thing.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Time is one thing I don't have a lot of.
Despite deploying over 100 mass-produced Nikkes, numerous long-ranged weapons, and the Goddess Squad, the operation to topple the Queen ends in failure.
The Rapture forces near the Lift swell to four times its original size,
and the United Forces of Humanity determines that capturing the Lift is an impossible task.
A decision is made: all of the humans that remain will be evacuated to the Ark, a massive city being built underground.
Mankind has been defeated by Raptures.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Where's Lilith?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: She pushed herself to the limit and had to undergo maintenance. She'll be immobile for some time.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: So what happens next?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text:
Mankind will escape underground. 
The world will fall into the hands of Raptures.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: And humans will die out.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Not necessarily. From what I hear, the living conditions in the Ark are actually quite ideal.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: The only downside is its limitations with regard to size.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What do we do now?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: We help with the move.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: And after that?

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Most likely reside in the Ark and prepare for retaliation.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: All right, I'm calling it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'm at my limit.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I doubt I have many days left.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Today may well be my last.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Wh-what are you talking about? You said you'd stay with us until the end.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Sorry, kid. I lied.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'll die in my hometown. That was something I decided a long time ago.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: At first, I wanted to die on the battlefield, fighting alongside you all.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: But we managed to make it out alive.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So I'm going.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Y-you can't go.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I won't let you!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Snow...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Listen to me carefully.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: The wolf must die under the well.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Everyone has a predestined final resting place,

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'm not destined to die here.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Don't lie.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I know you want to stay here with us.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: You like this place.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: You were willing to die alongside us.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Fine, you got me.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: No more beating around the bush.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: This thing we call corruption,

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: it won't kill me, not directly at least.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: It will only end when someone else puts me out of my misery.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: If I stay here, the corruption will slowly take over me,

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: and you'll be forced to make a terrible choice.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: When the time comes...

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Will you be able to

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: go through with it?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Promise that you'll shoot me.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Y-yes! I'll do it!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: But will you be able to do it without crying?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You can't.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: You're all far too nice for that.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: The last thing I'll ever see is

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: all of you bawling your eyes out.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: What kind of final image

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: is that to go out on?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'd never want that.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: I'll go away... and die quietly.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: If that is your decision, I won't stop you.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: You've earned the right to choose for yourself.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Thank you, Boss, and everyone.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Dorothy, if you would, please restrain Snow White.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Hey, let me go! Let go!

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Be good,

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: kid.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: It's been fun.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Red Hood! Don't go!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Stay here with me! Please!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I-I'll pull the trigger when I have to! I promise!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I won't cry! I won't even flinch!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Just please, don't go!
Without a word, Red Hood turns around and starts walking.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Are you really going?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: You're leaving me?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Are you really...
Red Hood keeps walking.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Go, then!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Go and die alone!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I won't shed a single tear for you!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Baddie! Liar!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I hate you!
Red Hood disappears.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Red... Hood...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: D-don't go.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Don't leave me...
RED ASH: To be Continued
